result.title: UniField++: A Unified Agentic Framework with Loop Reasoning for MRI Field-Strength Enhancement
result.summary: MRI field-strength enhancement seeks to combine the accessibility of low-field scanners with the image quality of high-field scanners. Yet, existing methods remain prone to anatomical hallucinations, as uniform processing leaves difficult brain regions insufficiently examined and scarce paired data limit their learning of how tissue contrast and anatomical visibility change across field strengths. To address these challenges, we propose UniField++, a two-agent framework that unifies enhancement tasks across multiple field-strength transitions, including 64mT-to-3T and 3T-to-7T. Unified learning allows both the VLM-based planner and the flow-matching-based enhancer to draw on field-dependent image characteristics observed across tasks, rather than relying on a single transition. Trained with radiologists' annotations of hallucination-prone regions and corresponding correction plans, the planner predicts regional risk and formulates targeted restoration strategies. Guided by these plans, the enhancer performs loop reasoning along the flow-matching trajectory, repeatedly processing high-risk regions for additional refinement. Together, cross-transition learning and risk-guided refinement support anatomically faithful enhancement across field strengths. Across the evaluated tasks, UniField++ improves PSNR by an average of 2.74 dB and SSIM by 14.05 percentage points over comparison methods, with corresponding gains of 3.97 dB and 13.92 percentage points over the ablation baseline. It also maintains enhancement quality on an external cohort with an unseen field strength and improves downstream whole-brain segmentation Macro Dice by an average of 0.1457 over the original low-field images. Code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/UniField_plusplus.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UniField++，一个由 VLM 规划器与 flow-matching 增强器组成的双智能体框架，统一处理 64mT→3T、3T→7T 等 MRI 场强增强任务，规划器预测易出现解剖幻觉的区域并给出修复策略，增强器据此在轨迹上做 loop 精修。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「风险区域由 VLM 判定→驱动循环式迭代精修」的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算、证据筛选与停止决策提供方法线索；但文中 loop reasoning 属图像域修复迭代而非 latent 推理状态，是否具备状态更新与贡献分配层面的借鉴价值需核查原文。
